description: This source file defines a utility class 'LogUtil' for logging-related operations in an Akka-based Java application. It provides methods to obtain logging adapters, enhance logs with correlation IDs, manage MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) fields, and generate MDC field objects. It is tightly coupled with Akka actors, SLF4J MDC, and the project's header and condition checking utilities.

classes.name: LogUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing logging support functions such as MDC enhancement, correlation ID management, and obtaining logging adapters for Akka actors.

methods.name: obtain
methods.description: Returns a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter with MDC support for the specified actor.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Enhances the logging MDC with a correlation ID extracted from various header objects or directly provided.

methods.name: enhanceLogWithCorrelationIdOrRandom
methods.description: Adds a correlation ID to MDC, using the existing one if present or generating a new UUID.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the current correlation ID from MDC, if available.

methods.name: removeCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from MDC.

methods.name: newMdcField
methods.description: Creates a new MDC field object with specified name and value.

methods.name: obtain
methods.description: Returns a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter with MDC support for the provided actor.

methods.description: Adds a correlation ID, generating a random UUID if none exists.

methods.description: Fetches the correlation ID from MDC as an optional string.
